label: mid-input steps (t=4-6) of a sequence whose 2nd or 3rd token is h
explanation: Fires only during the original-input phase (97% of mass), mostly at t=4-6, with a little on the <DEL> step and nothing in the copy phase. It fires in sequences where an h appeared early, especially as original token 1 or 2 (prev2_tok=h has 6x lift). The current input token barely matters. It is strongest when several h tokens open the sequence (e.g. x h h h ...): with h at both positions 1 and 2, precision is 0.96, and every top example has that pattern. It does not fire at t<=2, at t>=9, or in the copy phase, and it is weak when the h comes later (position 3 or more) or is only the first token. The predicate captures about 81% of activation mass on dev (F1 0.64). False positives are sequences with an early h where the feature stays silent, and misses are low-magnitude activations with no early h.
